HOW WE PRICE IT
The smile fit

•  Black–Scholes inversion — 3 Newton steps / tick, warm-started
•  Smile IV = a + b·m + c·m²,  m = ln(K/S) / √T,  T = 5 days at open
•  GLS fit, vega² weights; shape smoothed 1,000 ticks, level refit each tick

•  r = mid − smile price, per strike
•  AR(1): φ = 0.992–0.994, half-life ~100 ticks; sd 2.1–5.3, widest 7,300–7,600
•  v = F + ρ·r,  ρ = φ¹²⁰ ≈ 0.43 — 57% reverts in 120 ticks
•  2σ at 7,500 (~10) ≈ 4.2 per lot after costs
